edition: Paderewski / Bronarski / Turczynski (PWM): model-reviewed pitches, attacks, rhythm and dynamic levels; not a facsimile edition
provenance: Derived from the NIFC M. Schlesinger first-edition encoding; corrected by complete both-staff model review against exact Paderewski Etudes PDF pp.59-63 (printed 58-62). Original retained separately.

verified_scope: chord membership and independent voice attacks
rhythm and sounding durations including written triplets
corrections: Recover RH bars 81-84 from an incorrectly simultaneous 16-quarter second voice in source bar 80; reconstruct its missing Ab4 whole note, G4/C4 and F4/C4 half-note voices and sustained C4 tie.
Restore RH inner voices at 70-72: D5 whole with two G4 half-note attacks, C5/G4 whole, then Ab4/F4 whole.
Correct LH G2 in 12, D#3 and F#2 in 30, F#3/A3 in 31, G#2 in 32, Db3 in 38, B2/Db4 in 55; retain exact sixteenth timing and distinguish fingerings from tuplets.
Correct RH C#4/F#4 in 31, G4 in 46 and Ab5/Ab4 in the triplet of 55.
Restore ties on common C5 at 22, Eb5/C5 at 62, the octave Eb4/Eb5 across 17-18 and 57-58, and C5 across 77-78.
Correct the closing runs: E-natural in both hands at 81, G4 in 82, and Db in the final descending groups of both hands at 81-82.
Retain actual RH tuplets at 50/52/55/56/60/62, sounding octaves and staff crossings. Restore scan-reviewed dynamics, sf/sfp accent words, and the closing smorzando/rallentando exemption.
